{{Quote|Thanks to your Tagge ''weapons detection system,'' and my own ''information control program--'' the Rebellion doesn't ''exist'' on Metalorn.|Governor Corwyth|<ref name="MSW30">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]]</ref>}}
The '''information control program''' was pioneered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Corwyth]] on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. It was a system of control over information and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] on Metalorn, allowing the Governor to keep his workers in total ignorance, save for the propaganda he wished them to know. For a time the program seemed to work well, to the extent that the workers of Metalorn did not even realize a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] existed, but the actions of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during the [[Mission to Metalorn (Galactic Civil War)|Mission to Metalorn]] revealed to some workers that they were being kept in ignorance. Leia Organa believed that this would result in workers rebelling against their Imperial masters.<ref name="MSW30" />
